_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/profile.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: One row per account and whether the operator approved it. The waitlist gate reads approved on every API call.
rules: approved_at is stamped by a trigger when approved flips on; the backend never writes it.

notified_at.note: The backend sends 'now()' once, guarded by notified_at is null.
